answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique radio operator certificate with communications regulator attestation flips the bet — a certificate the regulator renews after exams — and the ember lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the harbor of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The ridge is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
